g.text: When we execute a simple function it will return the response directly.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: But if we define a function with 'async' keyword, it looks like a simple function.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: However, it result into a Promise.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: That's the reason we say async/await is a syntactic sugar on top of Promises.
